country.evidence_source: The genetic data were obtained from Chiao and Blizinsky (2010) who estimated the 5-HTT short allele frequency in 31 countries, based on 124 peer-reviewed publications involving 50,135 individuals (the genetic database hereafter). Of the 31 countries 17 overlapped with countries/regions of origin in LSIA.
country.warning: The study uses a genetic database compiled from 31 countries, with 17 overlapping with LSIA. No single predominant country is specified, and listing all 31 is impractical for this field.

Outcome_variable.evidence_source: We analyzed long allele frequency because of its expected, positive relation with life satisfaction for ease of exposition.
